# Perplexity API changelog — captured 2026-08-14
# https://docs.perplexity.ai/changelog

## August 2026 — model roster additions to the Agent API only
- **Grok 4.6** (`xai/grok-4.6`) — "xAI's latest flagship reasoning and agentic model", now supported
  on the Agent API.
- **NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra** — $0.25 / MTok input or cached-input, $2.50 / MTok output.
- **NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning** — $0.0115 / MTok input; fast open-weight reasoning model.
- **DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731** — 1M-token context window, fast open reasoning model.

[All four are MODEL ADDITIONS to an already-inventoried API surface. Watching tier admits only major
new capabilities, and a wider model roster is not one. Nothing reported for Perplexity this scan.]

No new API surface, endpoint, agent capability, connector or tool this scan.

Updated: 2026-08-14 — model roster expanded; nothing above the bar.
